title: The Paper Fan for the Warm Queue
youtube_title: The Paper Fan for the Warm Queue | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A smaller piece, fairly given, can still be enough.
summary: At a bakery counter on a soft, busy morning, Nim sees that a paper fan while waiting in a warm queue will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Nim makes a smaller, even share so Brigid is included, and Ms. Okonkwo lets the choice stand without a speech.
